name: EDICOM
summary: EDICOM provides electronic invoicing and tax reporting under models such as CTC, post-audit, clearance, real-time reporting and Peppol. It states that it is a certified Peppol Access Point and offers long-term storage with qualified electronic signatures and time stamps. The site publishes no prices and asks visitors to request a demo.

facts.text: EDICOM says its platform adapts to regulatory models such as CTC, post-audit, clearance, real-time reporting and Peppol.
EDICOM states that it is a certified Peppol Access Point.
EDICOM offers long-term electronic storage with qualified electronic signatures and time stamps. The page does not name the countries whose archiving rules it covers.
The page names Mexico, Chile, Brazil and Turkey as countries where clearance applies, and Spain and France as examples of real-time reporting.
